Definition: from G1909 and a derivative of the latter part of G1971; yearned upon, i.e. greatly loved:--longed for.
BiblicalUsage: Epipothetos means longed for, greatly loved — and Paul calls the Philippians his brethren dearly beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, so stand fast in the Lord, my dearly beloved.
TheologicalSignificance: Not as a task, but as a joy and a crown: that is how Paul loved his people, longed for and not merely managed.
